title: Tech Note: Project Mode Conversion Assistant Component
author: Bryan Yen, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This tool is squarely tied to the binary-to-project-mode migration window; it remains directly useful today for any team still converting legacy binary (.4DB/.4DC) databases to project mode, a task that continues for organizations with older 4D applications.
related_updates: Project mode (introduced v17-18) is now 4D's default and recommended development mode; conversion assistants like this remain relevant precisely because many legacy binary databases still need migrating years later.

The underlying JSON conversion-log format this component parses has been stable since project mode's introduction, so this component should still function on current 4D versions doing binary-to-project conversions.
